bring_own_inspiration_share_structure.finding: A Bring-side share of one of Bring's OWN inspiration recipes is type=TEMPLATE and carries only a Bring-internal content id — NOT any external source URL. Safe by construction for Bring's own catalog.

device_observations.open_q7_test: Import an externally-sourced recipe (our capability-URL page), then use Bring's share button and decode the resulting link: is it type=TEMPLATE (Bring-internal, safe) or type=RECIPE carrying our source/capability URL? This is the decisive privacy test — pending.

q7_share_of_imported_recipe.verdict: NO — a Bring-side share does NOT propagate the source or capability URL
q7_share_of_imported_recipe.method: Kornelius imported recipes from our external raw.githubusercontent pages (incl. the capability-URL page with a secret path), then used Bring's share button and sent the resulting onelink back.
q7_share_of_imported_recipe.mechanism: On share, Bring re-uploads the recipe to its OWN template store (a fresh bringtemplates/content/<uuid>) and the share link (type=TEMPLATE) points to that internal id. The recipient receives a Bring content reference, never our external URL or its secret path. Same shape as Bring's own Inspiration shares.
q7_share_of_imported_recipe.residual_note: The recipe CONTENT is copied onto Bring's servers as a template; the source URL / capability token is NOT handed to the recipient. Whether Bring internally retains a linkOut inside the template content is a Bring-side retention question, not a third-party propagation one.
